title: WhatsApp is working on even more Liquid Glass interface changes - 9to5Mac
summary: Following the initial rollout of Liquid Glass on iOS earlier this year, WhatsApp is now working to bring the design to more interface elements. WhatsApp is now working on updating this progress bar to match the Liquid Glass design as well.
